question: Do late-iterate fluctuations hide a useful common predictor?
method: Arithmetic mean of4000/5000/6000 model parameters, applied to both continuation learning-rate arms. No optimizer updates.
comparison: Same fixed FIT/DEV panels against selected single checkpoint, then completeDEV if both panel bands improve>=0.05 versus continuation start.
design_status: Adaptive follow-up motivated by oscillating4000-step metrics; later checkpoints not yet observed. No officialVAL used.
